name: test_news_details_other_news_navigation
description: Verify opening another news article from the 'Інші новини' section.
descriptionHtml: Verify opening another news article from the 'Інші новини' section.

testStage.description: Verify opening another news article from the 'Інші новини' section.

steps.name: 1. Scroll down to the 'Інші новини' block
Get list of currently active news cards in carousel
2. Click the 'Детальніше' button on the selected card
Wait until the page URL equals the expected URL
Wait until the visible article title matches the expected text
